sentences.en: I like all sorts of Asian foods, particularly Thai food.
sentences.zh: 我挺喜欢各种亚洲食物，尤其是泰国菜。

sentences.en: Old habits die hard. This is particularly true of politics.
sentences.zh: 旧习惯难改。这一点在政治上尤其明显。

sentences.en: Our bus comes late, particularly when we are in a hurry.
sentences.zh: 我们的公交车经常迟到，尤其是在我们需要赶时间的时候。
